hook.name: LaunchGuardV4Hook
hook.description: Applies a decaying sell tax on token-to-WETH swaps: starts at 99% and linearly decays to 2% over 194 minutes post-launch. Collected WETH accumulates in an on-hook reserve and can be compounded into locked liquidity every 8 hours via an authorized router, with a keeper reward of up to 0.005 ETH paid to the caller.
